en.bdb: Joy of love is attained after great hardship

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੇਤੀ ਵਾੜਿ ਸੁ ਢਿੰਗਰੀ ਕਿਕਰ ਆਸ ਪਾਸ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: khetee vaaR su ddi(n)garee kikar aas paas jiau baagai|

en.bdb: Around the agricultural field the bushes are kept as fence and around the garden acacia. trees (for its safety) are planted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਪ ਪਲੇਟੇ ਚੰਨਣੈ ਬੂਹੇ ਜੰਦ੍ਰਾ ਕੁਤਾ ਜਾਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: sap paleTe cha(n)nanai boohe ja(n)dhraa kutaa jaagai|

en.bdb: The sandalwood tree is entwined by snakes and for the safety of treasure the lock is used and the dog also remains awake.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਵਲੈ ਕੰਡੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸਿਆਣਾ ਇਕੁ ਕੋਈ ਵਿਚਿ ਫਾਗੈ॥
verses.translit_en: kavalai ka(n)dde jaaneean siaanaa ik koiee vich faagai||

en.bdb: Thorns are known to live near flowers and during the ho/frevelty among the turbulent crowd one or two wise men also remain persent.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਥਰਾ ਮਣਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਜਿਉ ਕਾਲੈ ਨਾਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: jiau paaras vich patharaa man masatak jiau kaalai naagai|

en.bdb: As the jewel remains in the head of black cobra the philosopher's stone remains surrounded by stones.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨੁ ਸੋਹੈ ਗਲਿ ਪੋਤ ਵਿਚਿ ਮੈਗਲੁ ਬਧਾ ਕਚੈ ਧਾਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: ratan sohai gal pot vich maigal badhaa kachai dhaagai|

en.bdb: In the garland of jewels on both the side of a jewel glass is kept to protect it and the elephant remains tied with the thread cf love.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਵ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੁਖ ਜਾਇ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਦਰੁ ਖਵਾਲੈ ਪਿੰਨੀ ਸਾਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: bhaav bhagat bhukh jai ghar bidhar khavaalai pi(n)nee saagai|

en.bdb: Lord Krsna for his love for the devotees goes to Vidur's home when hungry and the latter offers him beans of sag, a green leafy vegetable.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਿਖ ਭਉਰ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਹਲੰਗੁ ਸਭਾਗੈ।
verses.translit_en: charan kaval gur sikh bhaur saadhasa(n)gat sahala(n)g sabhaagai|

en.bdb: The Sikh of the Guru becoming black bee of the lotus feet of the Guru, ought to attain good fortune in the holy congregation.
He should further know that cup of the love of the Lord is got after very hard
